lines.t: All week runnin' at a broken pace
Mind's still spinnin', I forget your face
Every headline weighin' on my mind
Chasing every deadline, leaving joy behind
City noises echoing inside
But when the sunset falls, I hear your gentle call
Shutting down the screens and all the lies
I feel your spirit whisper, child, just close your eyes
I lay my worries down, I leave them at your feet
Six days of chasing more, but here my soul can breathe
You quiet every fear, you calm the raging sea
On this holy Sabbath day, you're singing over me
This is my Sabbath, I rest in your arms
Under your shadow, I'm safe from the storm
All of the pressure is fading away
Here in your presence, I'm held by your grace
Breathing in mercy with every breath
On this holy day my heart finds rest
Here in your goodness I know I am blessed
On this Sabbath I find perfect rest
Morning light is pouring through the blinds
Coffee on the table, scripture open wide
Family gathered, every heart aligned
We trade our heavy stories for your peace of mind
Songs of praise are rising with the sun
Every broken heart believing you have won
We remember how you spoke and it was done
And how you rested on the seventh when the work was done
I lay my burdens down, I'm giving you control
Seven colors in the sky, a promise for my soul
You turn my restless nights into a gentle still
On this Sabbath I surrender to your perfect will
This is my Sabbath, I rest in your arms under your shadow
I'm safe from the storm, all of the pressure is fading away
Here in your presence, I'm held by your grace
Breathing in mercy with every breath
On this holy day, my heart finds rest
Here in your goodness, I know I am blessed
On this Sabbath, I find perfect rest
Let the weight fall off my shoulders
Let your peace roll like the ocean
Every fear is bowing lower
Yeah, Yeshua, you are my devotion
When the world keeps spinning faster
You remind me you're the master
In your rest I'm standing stronger
All I need is you no longer
This is my Sabbath, I rest in your arms
Under your shadow, I'm safe from the storm
All of the pressure is fading away
Here in your presence, I'm held by your grace
Breathing in mercy with every breath
On this holy day my heart finds rest
Yeah, who's sure my shelter, my peace and my friend
Sabbath in your love that never ends
Thanks for watching!
